consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the April 1, 1990 show at The Omni is a standout performance, showcasing the band's tight musicianship and memorable song selections. Highlights include impressive renditions of 'To Lay Me Down,' 'China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider,' and 'Stella Blue,' with many praising the overall energy and sound quality of the recording.
standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
It's All Over Now, Baby Blue
